videos.title: How Was the Great Wall of China Built? 🧱🇨🇳
videos.description:
2,000 years, many dynasties, over 21,000 km of walls: rammed earth pounded layer by layer, bricks glued with sticky rice mortar, hundreds of thousands of workers, and fire signals faster than a horse. And no, you can't see it from space.
Would you walk the whole thing? 👇

videos.title: How Is Glass Made? (It Used to Be a Beach) 🏖️🪟
videos.description:
Sand, soda ash and limestone, melted at 1,500 °C. The atoms freeze in a jumble, which is why glass is clear. Window glass floats on a bath of molten tin to come out perfectly flat, then cools slowly so it doesn't crack.
What everyday thing should I explain next? 👇

videos.title: Why Did Chernobyl Explode? (It Was a Safety Test) ☢️
videos.description:
April 26, 1986, 1:23 am. A test meant to make the reactor safer: power too low, almost every control rod pulled out, a design where more steam meant more power, and an emergency button whose rod tips briefly made things worse. The nearby town is still empty.
Would you visit Chernobyl today? 👇
